title: N1
author: Roderick Dong（董科含）
key_evidence: Describes an under-22 builder/researcher community with real projects, shared life/work, introductions and resources. Selection emphasizes existing self-direction.
limitations: Founder account; platform and newer School must be separated. Member achievements, scale and selectivity are self-reports, not measured training effects.

title: How to Identify Someone Worth Investing in at 20
author: Roderick Dong（董科含）
key_evidence: Selection heuristic values self-generated goals, action on curiosity and learning from mistakes; author describes a mistaken rejection.
limitations: A theory of recognizing talent and personal judgment, not a tested intervention that produces those traits.

title: 一群 AI Native 创始人，正在长出来
author: N1；原载公众号董科含，虎嗅转载
key_evidence: An evening session made participants' tools and workflows visible; a blind AI comparison used a shared prompt and anonymous voting.
limitations: Single organizer narrative. Embedded model-generated essays are not N1 policy or research evidence; no complete week or controlled comparison.

title: 客户做了什么，才算他真的需要你
author: N1；原载公众号董科含，虎嗅转载
key_evidence: An unnamed career-simulation project moves from letters of intent through customer objections and usage problems to a proposed smaller pilot.
limitations: No named product, repository, sales validation or later pilot outcome. Described next actions are not completed results.

title: 在模型持续进步的时代，年轻人真正应该押注什么
author: N1；匿名研究者及创业者讨论整理
key_evidence: Advice stresses reliable baselines, ablations, implementation constraints, revisable beliefs and following work through failure and revision.
limitations: Speakers are anonymous; advice is not a verified curriculum or evidence of participant learning. Technical forecasts not adopted as established facts.

title: 不要只做一个观众：一个 AI 时代年轻创业者的自我校准
author: 懒羊羊 Eason；原载公众号董科含，虎嗅转载
key_evidence: The author recalls motivation from N1 founder sharing and reflects on technical ownership, concrete collaboration and restless exploration.
limitations: Experiences also involve Meta, Stanford contacts and other communities. Attribution to N1 alone is unsupported; personal recollections not independently verified.

title: N1 Angel Collective | Participation Memo
author: Roderick Dong
source_date: Page displays May 28; year unreliable because template metadata conflicts
key_evidence: Describes an investor participation arrangement distinct from a learning program.
limitations: Used only to distinguish N1AC from School; investment terms do not describe student participation.
